title: UI Tweaks
description: Upgrades the Minecraft UI - Better Layout + better usage
body:
# UI Tweaks
UI Tweaks replaces the cluttered standard Minecraft interface layouts with a cleaner, more organized, and modern design. It reorganizes vanilla menus into logical groups, adds quality-of-life visual improvements, and ensures compatibility with buttons from other mods—all while keeping the classic vanilla aesthetic intact.

This is a client-side only mod. You do not need to install it on servers.

---

# Features
## Main Menu (Title Screen)
- Clean Layout: Reorganizes the standard buttons to the edges of the screen, freeing up the center to let your background panorama shine.
- Player Skin Widget: Displays a live, fully rendered 3D preview of your character's skin directly on the title screen.
- Smart Mod Support: Automatically detects buttons added by other mods (like ModMenu, Capify, etc.) and seamlessly aligns them into the new layout without overlapping.

## Options Screen
- Logical Grouping: Replaces the standard messy grid of 10 buttons by splitting them into four visually separated, logical sections:
  - Top Left: Video, Controls, Chat, Accessibility
  - Top Right: Music & Sounds, Skin Customization, Resource Packs
  - Bottom Left: Language
  - Bottom Right: Telemetry, Credits
- Dynamic Scaling: Scales perfectly and stays organized no matter what your window size or resolution is.

## Pause Menu (Game Menu)
- Split-Column Design: Splits the middle buttons (Advancements, Options, Statistics, etc.) into two distinct left and right columns with a wide, clean gap in the center.
- Prominent Actions: Pushes the "Back to Game" button further up and the "Save and Quit" button further down to prevent accidental misclicks.

## Compatibility
Built for Fabric 1.21+ (Specifically tested on 1.21.11).

---

**High Compatibility**
Designed to dynamically adapt to buttons added by other mods on the Title Screen.
